title: The model to be validated: x = A e^(−γt) cos ωt
caption: With A = 0.1 m, γ = 0.05 s⁻¹ and a 2 s period, the envelope A e^(−γt) falls to 0.037 m (1/e of A) at t = 1/γ = 20 s. Fitting γ and ω from one run, then predicting a different run and measuring it, tests the model.
alt: Damped oscillation of displacement against time inside a dashed exponential envelope that falls from 0.10 metres.
description: Displacement x = 0.1 e^(−0.05t) cos(πt) metres, period 2 s.
The dashed envelope ±0.1 e^(−0.05t) bounds the swings.
At t = 1/γ = 20 s the envelope is A/e = 0.037 m.
If γ depended on the amplitude, the model would fail: air drag proportional to v² would show up this way.
